name: cosend
description: Cosend runs your business's WhatsApp from your AI assistant over MCP: a shared WhatsApp inbox on the number you already use, WhatsApp campaigns to saved audiences, WhatsApp templates submitted for Meta's review, WhatsApp automation built from a plain description, an AI receptionist trained on your website and files, contacts, integrations and team reports. Every send, campaign, template, automation change and switch-on comes to you as a preview you approve.

interface.longDescription:
Cosend is the WhatsApp platform businesses run their customer conversations on. It puts your WhatsApp number in a shared inbox for the whole team while the WhatsApp Business app keeps working on your phone, and brings WhatsApp campaigns, WhatsApp templates, WhatsApp automation and an AI receptionist into the same workspace.

With Cosend in your assistant, you read, search and answer every WhatsApp chat, assign chats, snooze them, add internal notes and pass chats between teammates. You set up WhatsApp campaigns: pick a saved audience and an approved marketing template, see who gets it and Meta's list price, then send it or schedule it. You write WhatsApp templates, check them against Meta's rules and submit them for Meta's review. You keep contacts, tags, custom fields, CSV imports and consent records in order. You build WhatsApp automations from ready-made recipes or from a plain description, test them on a sample customer, deploy them and switch them on, and you see every run step by step. You train the AI receptionist on your website, files and Google Maps listing, set its persona and test it. You manage your WhatsApp numbers, your business profile and integrations such as Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Calendly, Shopify and Stripe, and you read reports on response times, the AI receptionist, each number and each teammate.

Every send, campaign, template, automation change and switch-on comes to you as a preview you approve. Connecting a WhatsApp number, connecting an app and billing happen on a secure set-up link you open in your own browser.
defaultPrompt: Show me the WhatsApp chats waiting for a reply today.
Set up a WhatsApp campaign for our weekend offer to our VIP customers.
Build an automation that welcomes first-time customers and answers their first questions.
